headline: I teach machines to see, to forget, and to help.
subheading: AI & Computer Science Student | Builder | Researcher
intro: Between a dataset and a farmer's field there's a gap where a model stops being an idea and has to become useful. That gap is where I like to work. I'm a student from Vijayawada who built Kisan AI to bring crop prices, weather and crop advice to farmers in their own language, wrote a published paper on how trained models can unlearn what they were taught, and am now researching how robots can find their way through places that were never designed for them.
pipelineTitle: How I work, written as a model would see it

pipeline.v: Explain: write it down so others can use it.
Apply: put it in front of real people.

storyLead: I don't just learn about technology. I build it, research it, explain it and try to put it to work, and I care about the people on the other side of it.
closing: Someone who doesn't just learn about technology, but builds, researches, explains and applies it.
